subject: general
question: Seven friends, J, K, L, M, N, O and P, are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre and at equal distance from each other (not necessarily in the same order). K sits fifth to the left of M. O sits second to the left of M. L is an immediate neighbour of M and sits fourth to the left of P. J is not an immediate neighbour of K. Which among the following pairs denotes the immediate neighbours of N?
solution: 1) K sits fifth to the left of M. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9448c7aaf263ddd644b8d6ab363a3554c457ed42443e379600a840fc9a5c3a83.png] 2) O sits second to the left of M.
